answer: Wesbanco's 2021 TSRP grants were made contingent upon stockholder approval because the Compensation Committee's annual grant of TSRP awards to certain officers was made contingent upon approval of the Restated Incentive Plan by stockholders at the Annual Meeting, due to capacity limitations on the number of shares of Restricted Stock available under the Current Incentive Plan [1].
